{{Faction Infobox |title = Lollo Logistics |image = Lollo Logistics Logo.png|Logo Lollo Logistics.jpg|Key Art |nation = Multinational }} {{Description|Lollo Logistics is a trusted logistics company that delivers not only the tangible, but also the intangible.
Whether it's sending sweet words to a loved one or retrieving lost memories, if it's ordered and can be delivered, Lollo Logistics will handle them with care.}} '''Lollo Logistics''' is a professional multinational logistics expertise, offering services for all items—tangible or intangible—as long as they can be delivered, ensuring secure and reliable transport. Whether in bustling cities or remote wilderness, Lollo Logistics stations are established to meet clients' delivery needs. Guided by a shared creed, the couriers prioritize their clients' property. Their couriers don an iconic hamster-themed outfit. ==Organization== ===Couriers=== Lollo Logistics' couriers are responsible for collecting and delivering packages on behalf of clients.
